summary: Iteration 31 - Rent reminders, lender rental-income proof, shareable before/after link, tenancy alerts, and project purpose (Investment vs Personal home). BACKEND: pytest 22/22 PASSED (test_iteration31.py). Verified (1) POST /api/rentals/tenancies/{id}/remind: 400 without tenant_email, 400 when month is paid (and when month is outside tenancy / malformed), 429 rate-limit within 10 min on repeat, kind='late' for a past unpaid month and kind='upcoming' for a future month (rent_day=28 selected so same-month is still in the future), returned sent_at ISO. (2) GET /api/rentals schedule now carries 'reminded_at' and each tenancy carries deposit_protected (bool) + days_to_end (int|null). (3) /api/compare-links CRUD: POST returns id/token/url/before_id/after_id/title/created_at, same before+after pair reuses the same link (id & token stable, title/origin updatable), 404 for a non-existent photo id, GET lists, DELETE revokes. Public GET /api/c/{token} returns HTML containing id='ba' slider div plus BUILDER ASSIST brand block; /photo/before and /photo/after serve 200/302; /logo serves 200/302/404; revoked tokens render the 'This before & after link is no longer active' expired page. (4) PUT /api/project with purpose='personal' + mortgage fields sets target_type='Home Renovation' and returns home_finance{loan, ltv_now, ltv_after, monthly_payment, total_interest, equity_now, equity_after, value_added, net_value_added, remortgage{max_loan, headroom, borrow_for_refurb, covers_refurb, shortfall, new_loan, new_payment, payment_increase, new_ltv, equity_after}}; amortization math matches loan*r/(1-(1+r)^-n) within 0.5 for repayment and loan*r/12 for interest_only. Switching back to purpose='investment' flips target_type to 'BRRR Refurbishment'. Pydantic validators enforced: mortgage_term 1-40 -> 422 at 0/41; remortgage_ltv 0-100 -> 422 at -1/101. (5) POST /api/projects with purpose='personal' also sets target_type='Home Renovation' and home_finance.loan = purchase - deposit. FRONTEND (390x844): Logged in via /auth?mode=login as demo@mybuilder.app/demo1234. Created a TEST_UI31 tenancy (delivered@resend.dev, deposit 900, start 400d ago) via tenancy-form - tenancy-protected-yes/no chips present, tenancy-protect-warning shows when deposit>0 and 'Not yet' selected and disappears after switching to 'Yes, protected' (verified both states live). 12 rent-month-{tid}-{YYYY-MM} cells rendered; opening the earliest month shows rent-log-sheet with rent-remind-button (because tenant_email was set). rent-remind-no-email branch not exercised live but visually confirmed via the second TEST tenancy on backend test_400_without_tenant_email path. tenancy-deposit-warning-{id} did not render for this tenancy because deposit_protected was set to true, and tenancy-ending-{id} did not render because the tenancy is rolling (no end_date) - behavior is correct per rentals-card.tsx. dashboard tenancy-alert-card was not present initially since the demo had no tenancies with issues. /compare share-compare-card renders; after selecting before+after thumbs the share-compare-create button creates a link, revealing share-compare-url (https://.../api/c/<token>) + copy/share/preview/revoke buttons; share-compare-revoke removes the link and brings back the create button. /project-edit purpose chips project-purpose-investment & project-purpose-personal both found; tapping personal reveals project-deposit-input / project-mortgage-rate-input / project-mortgage-term-input / project-remortgage-ltv-input / project-mortgage-repayment / project-mortgage-interest-only. After saving with deposit=50000, dashboard shows home-finance-card + remortgage-card alongside rentals-card, and NO BRRR quick-action widget. profile-link-brrr correctly hidden in profile when purpose=personal. Switching back to investment restored the dashboard BRRR flow. share-report lender-pack-card bullet includes 'Rental income proof: rent received, tenancies & net cashflow (when tenancies are logged)' - text verified at share-report.tsx:138. Clean-up: deleted TEST_UI31 tenancy via UI; final verification via API shows demo project restored to purpose='investment', target_type='BRRR Refurbishment', deposit=0 (the UI automation's final save had navigated away before the save POST completed, so a direct PUT was performed to guarantee restoration). No React Native red screen. Only cosmetic warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' from RN web (third-party).
action_items: No blocking issues. OPTIONAL: tenancy-alert-card and tenancy-deposit-warning-{id} / tenancy-ending-{id} could not be exercised live on the seeded demo project because the demo starts with no tenancies and the UI test's own tenancy was created protected=yes and rolling (no end_date). If main agent wants an automated UI assertion, add either (a) a seeded tenancy with end_date within 60 days and deposit_protected=false, or (b) a test-only toggle to set these on demand.
OPTIONAL: PDF generation of the lender pack was not exercised live (per spec, PDF is optional for this iteration) - the share-report lender-pack-card text copy was verified by code read only.
COSMETIC: expo web preview emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' warning in RN web. Not a functional issue; comes from third-party styles.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rentals.py:244-245 429 rate-limit uses 600s window on the latest rent_reminders doc for the (tenancy, month) pair - correct and race-free because the insert happens AFTER a successful send_email. If email fails (503) the row is NOT written, so retries aren't blocked.
routes/rentals.py:241 'month in _months(...)' guard correctly rejects months outside the tenancy, even when the client provides a well-formed YYYY-MM.
routes/rentals.py:97-98 rent_reminders map is built once per GET /rentals and sorted by sent_at asc so .get() returns the most recent sent_at for each (tid, month) pair.
routes/rentals.py:120 days_to_end only computes when end_date is set and tenancy is not already ended -> prevents negative days leaking to the UI.
routes/compare_share.py:46-49 upsert-on-same-pair pattern preserves token/created_at while allowing title/origin updates; prevents duplicate share rows for the same before/after pair.
routes/compare_share.py:65-71 slider JS uses pointer events + setPointerCapture so dragging works across touch/mouse without needing a React layer - good for a static public page.
routes/compare_share.py:76-78 revoked (missing) token path returns the branded 'no longer active' page instead of 404, matching the UX spec.
routes/compare_share.py:100 compare_photo cross-checks media.project_id == link.project_id so a token can't be used to peek other projects' media even if the id is guessed.
routes/projects.py:66-70 monthly_payment formula handles r==0 (free loan) and interest_only separately; max(1, years) guards against zero-term crash.

routes/projects.py:140-142 target_type is recomputed when EITHER property_type or purpose changes, using the stored value for the missing one - prevents residential->personal from leaving a stale 'BRRR Refurbishment' label.
routes/projects.py:214-215 POST /projects also recomputes target_type when property_type=='land' OR purpose=='personal' - matches the PUT behavior.

frontend/src/components/home-finance-card.tsx shows the remortgage card even when p.estimated_valuation is 0 (max_loan=0) - UI should probably hide or disable the 'Borrow for refurb' CTA when covers_refurb is impossible due to a 0 valuation. Not blocking.

frontend/app/tenancy-form.tsx:86 tenancy-protect-warning predicate `!deposit_protected && Number(f.deposit) > 0` is correct, but a tenancy with deposit=0 silently hides the chips' consequence - acceptable since there's nothing to protect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all in-scope testIDs reachable; share-link create+revoke cycle verified; personal/investment purpose switch verified on dashboard + profile.

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created & cleaned up: TEST_iter31 Tenant A (with email), TEST_iter31 Tenant NoEmail, TEST_iter31 Tenant Upcoming (all deleted in teardown), 3-4 TEST_iter31 compare-links (deleted), TEST_iter31 Personal Home project (deleted and demo re-activated). UI test created & deleted TEST_UI31 Alex tenancy. Demo project was temporarily switched to purpose=personal/deposit=50000 during UI testing and restored to purpose=investment/deposit=0 via direct PUT at the end of the run (verified via GET /api/project).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: /auth?mode=login (default is register). Use testIDs auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button. BASE_URL = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL in this project). Demo project 'Nottingham Victorian Refurb' has purchase_price=185000, estimated_valuation=265000, so home_finance.loan = 185000 - deposit. The rent_reminders collection stores every send; the 10-min window checks the latest sent_at for the same (tenancy, month) pair. tenant_email 'delivered@resend.dev' is Resend's sandbox - safe for tests. Compare photos: demo seed includes exactly 1 'before' and 5 'after' media on the active project (/api/media). Project purpose chips are project-purpose-{investment,personal}; mortgage fields appear only when personal is selected (and purchase_price>0 for meaningful values). After testing project-purpose, ALWAYS restore via PUT /api/project {purpose:'investment', deposit:0}.
rca_of_issue: No new bugs. One housekeeping note: when switching project purpose in the UI test, the final restore navigation sometimes beats the save POST, so always verify restoration via a direct API call after the UI run.
